headline: Lead AWS DevOps Engineer
page_title: Rajendra P N - AWS DevOps Technical Mentor
summary_html: Lead AWS DevOps Engineer with 10 years of experience in cloud engineering, CI/CD automation, and production operations. Combines AWS infrastructure, CloudFormation, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, and troubleshooting with learner 1:1 sessions, technical presentations, group Q&A, and cross-team communication. Helps engineers understand deployment workflows, source-control standards, cloud dependencies, and operational diagnostics through practical guidance and reusable documentation. Builds Python/FastAPI automation and supports GPU-enabled Kubernetes and vector-search workloads, bringing applied AI-platform context to technical discussions.

achievements.text: Connects AWS infrastructure, CloudFormation, CI/CD, container orchestration, monitoring, and production diagnostics to practical engineering use cases.
Coaches development teams on Git workflows, branch governance, merge standards, and repeatable deployment practices.
Creates deployment guides and runbooks and engineers GPU-enabled Kubernetes and vector-search platforms for AI application workloads.

experience.title: Lead DevOps Engineer
impact: Architected reusable CI/CD pipelines with AWS CodePipeline and GitHub workflows to automate build, test, and release execution across engineering teams.

Established Git branching, approval, and artifact versioning standards and integrated DevSecOps controls into release workflows through secure secrets handling, Terraform validation, and pre-deployment policy checks across AWS environments.
Implemented secure service connectivity using AWS PrivateLink, VPC endpoints, and private networking controls to protect sensitive application traffic.
Standardized deployment pipelines for AWS and hybrid environments, improving release consistency, auditability, and operational reliability.
Developed Python, Bash, and PowerShell automation for provisioning, platform support, and recovery workflows, reducing manual operational effort.
Managed self-hosted runners, build agents, and distributed deployment infrastructure to optimize pipeline throughput across controlled compute environments.
Directed release planning across engineering teams, aligning dependencies, change windows, delivery risks, and production support.
Coordinated incident response and production release support, minimizing downtime and accelerating service restoration during high-priority events.
Guided engineering teams through deployment workflows, environment dependencies, and operational runbooks, explaining implementation choices and troubleshooting steps.
Reviewed pipeline and infrastructure changes with engineers, connecting Git branching, validation checks, security controls, and release readiness to practical delivery scenarios.
Designed Terraform-based EKS infrastructure for high-throughput vector search and GPU-enabled workloads, integrating repeatable provisioning with container delivery.
Authored deployment guides, architecture documentation, and operational runbooks that explain provisioning prerequisites, release steps, validation, and recovery procedures for engineering teams.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
impact: Deployed and administered self-hosted and auto-scaling build agents for Linux and Windows workloads to support high-throughput CI/CD operations.

Improved Kubernetes release processes by standardizing deployment patterns, secure runner standards, controlled branch protections, container image validation, and pipeline checks across environments.
Coached development teams on GitLab workflows, branch governance, and merge standards, clarifying source-control practices and resolving delivery-process questions.
Migrated Jenkins pipelines to GitLab CI and modernized runner configuration to improve maintainability and pipeline reliability.
Implemented GitLab CI best practices, including reusable templates, pipeline governance, and controlled branch-based execution.
Administered Kubernetes clusters and deployed applications through pods, deployments, services, and core platform components.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer II
impact: Implemented GitHub Actions workflows for deploying services to Kubernetes clusters across multiple environments.
Implemented disaster recovery, backup, and observability controls using AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery, AWS Backup, and Amazon CloudWatch.
Provisioned AWS infrastructure using CloudFormation, Terraform, and pipeline-driven infrastructure-as-code deployment patterns.
Designed secure VPC networking, Route 53 DNS, security groups, load balancing, VPN connectivity, Direct Connect, and traffic-routing patterns for enterprise workloads.
Established and maintained CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, Git, Amazon ECR, and Kubernetes for repeatable application delivery.
Deployed Kubernetes microservices through Argo CD-based GitOps workflows.
Built Docker images and deployed containerized applications to EKS using Helm charts and Kubernetes manifests.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Senior SRE
impact: Standardized GitHub Actions-based CI/CD patterns to accelerate software delivery and reduce pipeline drift across teams.
Developed internal APIs in Python FastAPI to integrate Jenkins, Jira, and JFrog processes with platform automation.
Developed custom Prometheus exporters in Python to capture application-specific operational metrics for SRE use cases.
Designed and delivered a Terraform and Kubernetes solution for payment-platform deployments, enabling repeatable infrastructure provisioning and container orchestration.
Built resilient Ansible roles and playbooks to deploy highly available Grafana, Prometheus, and Node Exporter monitoring stacks.
Administered CloudBees Jenkins, JFrog Artifactory, and Xray enterprise tooling for secure software delivery.
Developed Jenkins shared libraries to automate image versioning and publish artifacts to private JFrog repositories.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
impact: Supported enterprise applications on AWS by troubleshooting CloudWatch, Amazon RDS, load balancing, auto scaling, certificate management, CloudFront, and identity integrations.
Built continuous delivery pipelines and supported REST-based microservices deployments across Demo, Test, Pentest, Training, CTDEV, Sandbox, UAT, and PROD environments.
Automated fleet-level configuration enforcement for Linux and Windows EC2 instances and managed secure access and database connectivity in line with enterprise security standards.
Built Kubernetes environments with pods, deployments, services, and ConfigMaps, and managed Helm-based release packaging for multi-namespace workloads.
Used CloudFormation and PowerShell scripting to provision and manage cloud resources in a repeatable and auditable manner.
Served as acting scrum master by managing stories, epics, sprint commitments, and core scrum ceremonies.

experience.title: DevOps Engineer
impact: Authored and maintained Terraform modules and executed infrastructure changes through automated CI/CD workflows.
Executed Terraform deployments through pipelines and promoted the same artifact set across multiple environments through controlled environment selection.
Authored AWS CLI automation to update service configurations and standardize administrative operations.
Created deployment pipelines with Ansible to promote releases from development through production in a controlled, repeatable manner.
Defined and implemented branching strategies for Git repositories to improve release governance and code promotion.

experience.title: Build & Release Engineer
impact: Supported application builds, release packaging, and deployment coordination for the Expedia Travel Portal across development and test environments.
Prepared shell scripts for deployment preparation, configuration checks, and log collection to simplify recurring release support tasks.
Maintained version-controlled build configurations and release documentation, tracking artifact versions and environment-specific settings.
Partnered with developers and QA to investigate build and deployment failures, verify application smoke tests, and support release handovers.
